subject: FluxGrid renewal: usage health, Dedicated pilot & quantization plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Liang <sophie@fluxgrid.ai>, Ekram Salim <ekram.salim@fluxgrid.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: FluxGrid renewal: usage health, Dedicated pilot & quantization plan

Hi Sophie / Ekram —

Quick summary from our side ahead of the renewal conversation next month. I pulled the last 90 days of usage to highlight cost/levers and one operational item we flagged in monitoring. Attaching a compact CSV and a latency trace for context.

Top-line usage (last 90 days):
- Total tokens consumed: ~52.4M
- Embedding calls: ~2.2M (heavy due to vector search refresh cadence)
- Model mix: 62% rw-embed-3, 28% rw-7B-quant (int8 candidate), 10% open-instruct-3B (ad-hoc)

Operational note: we observed intermittent latency spikes impacting eu-west routing on 2028-04-02 (see latency_trace_20280402.png). Routing fell back to us-east for a short window which pushed up tail latency for a small subset of calls. We traced it to a transient pop on the eu host group; no data loss, but it does affect perceived SLA for EU customers.

Renewal options I recommend (to simplify decisioning):
1) Hosted 12-month commit (baseline): lock 5M tokens/month; 20% burst credits; standard hosted routing.
2) Dedicated pilot (recommended for throughput + cost): 8-week pilot with a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent GPUs), int8 quant profile for rw-7B-quant, automatic prefix caching enabled. Estimated token cost reduction ~38% after batching + quantization for the rw-7B workload.
3) Private (VPC) evaluation: if FluxGrid wants EU-only residency for inference and KMS integration we can scope a Private deployment after pilot.

Why Dedicated pilot? Pilot gives you predictable throughput for vector refreshes (embedding-heavy windows) and lets us validate your real-world latency headroom and cost delta without full commit. Typical timeline: onboarding smoke 2 business days, 2-week canary (10% traffic), then expand if green. We can also run your eval prompt set during the pilot to validate quality delta from int8 quant.

Ask from you:
- Confirm if FluxGrid would like to try the 8-week Dedicated pilot in us-east (we can mirror to eu-west if needed).
- Procurement contact for PO/DocuSign (I’ll send an amendment).
- Any specific eval prompts you want us to run during the pilot.

I’ve attached: fluxgrid_monthly_usage_Mar2028.csv and latency_trace_20280402.png.

If helpful I can draft a one-page amendment that converts your current monthly spend into a pilot + commit path with projected savings and rollback guardrails.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: fluxgrid_monthly_usage_Mar2028.csv, latency_trace_20280402.png

From: Sophie Liang <sophie@fluxgrid.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ekram Salim <ekram.salim@fluxgrid.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FluxGrid renewal: usage health, Dedicated pilot & quantization plan

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary.

FluxGrid is interested in a Dedicated pilot but we have a couple of constraints:
- We need pilot capacity in us-east first (primary traffic) and a mirror in eu-west only if the pilot demonstrates stable latency under our nightly ingestion windows.
- We require a 60-day pilot rather than 8 weeks if that gives us more time for ingestion stress tests.
- Please share a security/controls checklist up front — SOC 2 scope, KMS integration approach, and where logs/audit trails will live. Our procurement contact is Mary Roberts (mary.roberts@fluxgrid.com).

Two commercial asks: can you provide an itemized monthly price for the Dedicated config (GPU pool + reserved baseline + burst credits) and a clear rollback clause if we see >5% degradation in model quality (we'll provide an eval set).

If you can send those items I’ll route to Mary and legal.

— Sophie
Head of Platform, FluxGrid

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Liang <sophie@fluxgrid.ai>, Ekram Salim <ekram.salim@fluxgrid.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxGrid renewal: usage health, Dedicated pilot & quantization plan

Sophie — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Looping Laura (AE) and Monica (CS) to align on pricing, onboarding, and the pilot runbook.

Answers & next steps:
- Pilot length: we can do 60 days in us-east with an optional eu-west mirror if the canary metrics are green at 30/45 days.
- Pricing (itemized estimate for pilot, monthly):
  * Dedicated baseline (2x A100-equivalent pool, reserved): $9,200/month
  * Additional burst credits (20% of baseline): included in pilot
  * Monitoring & eval suite + prompt-run: $1,500 one-time setup
  * Estimated token cost during pilot (with batching + int8): effective $0.00028/token (appx) vs hosted $0.00045/token today — projected savings ~38% on rw-7B-quant workloads.
- Rollback & quality: we will run the eval set you provide daily; Monica will configure an automated regression alert if quality drops >2% on key metrics or if latency SLA degrades past agreed thresholds. We will include a rollback clause in the amendment: immediate reversion to hosted routing and a 2-week remediation window; credits apply if remediation takes longer.
- Security: SOC 2 summary and KMS integration notes attached separately (we'll provide the full security checklist today). For pilot we can support customer-managed KMS (via our KMIP path) and audit logs will be stored in your account with 90-day retention by default.

Attachments: proposed_dedicated_config.yaml (config + sizing), fluxgrid_monthly_usage_Mar2028.csv

Monica / Laura — can you start the onboarding checklist and share a HubSpot task. Laura, I’ve penciled in a pricing amendment draft for DocuSign once Mary confirms PO details.

Aditya

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FluxGrid renewal: usage health, Dedicated pilot & quantization plan

Thanks — I’ll take lead on the pilot onboarding. Plan & immediate asks:
1) I will create a pilot workspace and schedule a 2-hour kickoff call next Tuesday to walk the infra team through the Dedicated pool and KMS flow.
2) Ops plan: we’ll run your eval prompt set (please share) and a nightly embedding refresh stress test for 7 nights to surface tail behavior. If we see >3x baseline tail latency we’ll throttle ingestion and expand cache TTLs.
3) Quality monitoring: I’ll set up a daily evaluation job and a regression alert at 2% absolute drop on our selected metrics. If triggered we’ll pause traffic expansion and revert to hosted routing per the rollback clause.
4) Procurement: I’ll coordinate the PO with Mary — Mary indicated she’ll aim to send a formal PO (PO-8672) if the pricing looks acceptable; I’ll request the PO PDF once received.

I’ve attached the internal pilot runbook link and will upload the purchase_order_PO-8672.pdf when FluxGrid sends it.

Onboarding tasks I’ll own: pilot workspace, KMS handshake, eval run, smoke test, and daily dashboard for FluxGrid stakeholders. Laura — can you own the amendment/DocuSign once Mary confirms PO details?

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments (to be uploaded): purchase_order_PO-8672.pdf
